messages:
Liam (AE): FYI procurement at Bluecrest paused the POC contract signing. CISO needs SSO + explicit egress lock before PO. They want SCIM deprovision + zero-external-logs guarantee. Need legal + security triage.

Priya (SE): We support SAML + OIDC and SCIM v2. For POC the fastest is to provide static outbound IPs; peering / private link will add ~3-5 business days and infra tickets.

Zoe (Legal): please paste procurement wording. If it's just an addendum restricting egress and telemetry we can do a 1-paragraph addendum and sign off within 24h. BYO-KMS or escrow is a no-go without exec ok.

Liam (AE): procurement message: "SAML SSO (IdP-initiated), SCIM provisioning + deprovisioning, egress restricted to customer-supplied CIDRs, and an assurance that no operational logs or payloads are exported outside our VPC." They asked for a signed addendum by EOD Fri.

Marco (Security): "no logs leave VPC" is tricky. We can support IP-restricted egress and restrict our support telemetry to anonymized error + perf metrics. If they demand zero telemetry we need an exception review. Recommend we offer: IP allowlist for POC + a signed telemetry carveout (30d retention, limited access).

Priya (SE): Proposed POC outbound ranges we can commit to:

34.83.100.0/24
34.83.101.0/24

SAML SP metadata: https://redwood.example/saml/bluecrest-sp.xml
SCIM: token-based short-lived token OK.

Jana (CS): I can coordinate the SSO test slot. Bluecrest CSM is available Tue 9:00 AM PT or Wed 11:00 AM PT. Which works for SE?

Liam (AE): lock Wed 11:00 PT for the SSO window. Priya, can you join? Also need Zoe's addendum draft before the test.

Zoe (Legal): drafting now. Will propose: (1) POC IP allowlist only; (2) telemetry limited to anonymized support logs, retained 45 days; (3) no BYO-KMS or escrow for POC. Sharing PR in 2 hours.

Marco (Security): I'll review network diagram. Action: Liam please upload Bluecrest network/dataflow so I can confirm the CIDRs are compatible.

Priya (SE): uploaded: https://internal.bluecrest/diagrams/poc-network (perm requested)

ops-bot: Ticket created NET-5234 (POC egress IPs / peering) assigned to eng-network. ETA 48h if peering needed, 4h if IP allowlist.

Rosa (VP-Sales): If legal needs exec approval for any exceptions, I can jump on a quick call Thu morning. Keep me posted by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (AE): plan: Zoe to share addendum PR, Marco to confirm if IP allowlist suffices, Priya to provide IPs + SAML metadata, Jana to schedule SSO test Wed 11:00 PT. If any blocker persists by 18:00 Tue escalate to Rosa. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
